name: Willy Chotzen
occupation: State Representative; former public defender and teacher

bio.statement: His official biography says he was a middle school math teacher and later Chief Attorney in Portland's public defenders office.
bio.excerpt: Chief Attorney in Portland’s public defenders office

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Chotzen member page

bio.statement: Ballotpedia lists a law degree from Harvard Law School (2019) and a bachelor's degree from Washington University in St. Louis (2013).
bio.excerpt: a law degree from Harvard Law School

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Chotzen's occupation as State Representative and attorney, with a background as a public defender and public school teacher.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative; Attorney Occupational Background: Public Defender; Public School Teacher

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Harvard Law School (JD) and Washington University in St. Louis (BA) as his educational background.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Harvard Law School (JD); Washington University in St. Louis (BA)

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists State Representative as his prior governmental experience.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Chotzen listed expanding access to mental health care and addiction treatment as a priority.
positions.excerpt: I WILL EXPAND ACCESS TO MENTAL HEALTH CARE AND ADDICTION TREATMENT.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

positions.statement: In the same 2024 survey, Chotzen listed addressing homelessness and supporting affordable housing construction.
positions.excerpt: I WILL ADDRESS HOMELESSNESS AND SUPPORT CONSTRUCTION OF AFFORDABLE HOUSING.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

positions.statement: In the same 2024 survey, Chotzen listed public education for every child as a priority.
positions.excerpt: I WILL ENSURE A WORLD-CLASS PUBLIC EDUCATION FOR EVERY CHILD.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

positions.statement: Chotzen says in his pamphlet statement that he spearheaded an immigrant justice package that strengthened anti-discrimination laws, required ICE agents to unmask and reinforced sanctuary protections at schools and hospitals.
positions.excerpt: I spearheaded the legislature’s immigrant justice package, which strengthened anti-discrimination laws, required ICE agents to unmask, and reinforced sanctuary protections at schools and hospitals.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Chotzen says in his pamphlet statement that he has fought to stand up for working people, combat wage theft and lower utility costs.
positions.excerpt: Stand up for working people, combat wage theft, and lower utility costs.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Chotzen says in his pamphlet statement that he worked to protect consumers from predatory businesses and strengthen data privacy for kids.
positions.excerpt: Protect consumers from predatory businesses and strengthen data privacy for kids.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Chotzen says in his pamphlet statement that he defends access to reproductive healthcare, including funding Planned Parenthood and strengthening medical privacy.
positions.excerpt: Defend access to reproductive healthcare, including funding Planned Parenthood and strengthening medical privacy.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Chotzen lists strengthening schools among his re-election priorities in his pamphlet statement.
positions.excerpt: I’m running for re-election to prioritize affordability, strengthen our schools, hold data centers accountable, expand access to quality, affordable childcare

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 54

Pamphlet statement also lists general affordability, consumer protection, and protecting democracy from federal overreach (not itemized separately)
